Subject: Candidate Lina Gomez — comp expectations and location specifics

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the intro call last week. Quick follow-up on Lina Gomez (Senior ML Engineer) — she is based in Madrid and has a current base of EUR 95,000. She is open to a move to a remote role; her expected range is EUR 105k–115k depending on benefits and whether we apply a local-market uplift.

Recruiting asked if Redwood has a standard approach when a candidate is EU-based but being hired on a US band (i.e., how we apply location adjustments / salary floors). Also, the hiring manager (Acme Analytics) would prefer a clean offer number this week so they can pull the candidate into an active pipeline.

Are there guidelines or a quick approval path we should follow here? If you want, I can share Lina's CV and interview feedback.

Best,

Looping Maya and Marcus — recruiting hit me about Lina (Madrid). ACME wants a firm offer asap.

Quick context: we typically hire to band midpoints and then apply a location-specific uplift when the candidate is outside our primary US cost center. For Madrid we've used a +5–8% local-market uplift historically, but I can't remember the current floor rules for senior ICs.

Ask: can Marcus confirm the salary floor/midpoint mapping for Band 5 Senior ML Eng and whether we should treat Madrid as a COLA city (i.e., apply uplift on top of the US band) or map to an EU-specific floor? Also cc'ing Monica for headcount/approval cadence — if we need an exception to move above the midpoint, what's the fastest route (expedited approval vs full comp committee)?

Thanks — Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Talent & People Ops
Redwood Inference
(attachment forwarded: Lina_Gomez_CV.pdf)

From: marcus_lin@redwood.com
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com, maya_srinivasan@redwood.com
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 10:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Candidate Lina Gomez — comp expectations and location specifics

Thanks for the ping. I dug into the latest comp grid (attached). Short answers up front:

- Band: Senior ML Engineer at Redwood is Band 5 (IC4/IC5 split depends on scope). Midpoint (US) for Band 5 = USD 220,000.
- EU handling: For EU remote hires we maintain a localized floor table rather than converting USD directly. For Madrid specifically, our current policy (Q1–Q2 2027) uses a location adjustment of +6% on top of the USD-equivalent floor for roles at Band 4 and above, to account for local taxes and market competitiveness.
- Salary floor vs midpoint: We try to offer at or above the local floor. Midpoints are negotiable but moves above midpoint require comp committee sign-off if >12% above midpoint.

For Lina: converting USD floor to EUR at today's internal rate (1 USD = 0.93 EUR) and applying the +6% Madrid uplift gives an effective local floor ~ EUR 102,000 and a reasonable target offer range EUR 105k–112k. That aligns closely with recruiting's expectation.

Headcount/approval: if hiring manager wants to go above EUR 112k (~>10% above our local midpoint), we need an expedited comp exception: monica -> VP People Ops approval (email approval is acceptable for <15% exceptions). If the request goes beyond 15%, it must go to full comp committee (two-week turnaround typically).

I've attached: Comp_Grid_Q2_2027_v3.xlsx (band midpoints, local floors) and Madrid_Market_Adjustments_2027.pdf (short rationale and benchmarking sources).

Let me know if you want me to pre-authorize a one-time exception up to +10% so recruiting can present a firm offer today.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Compensation & Analytics Lead, People Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Comp_Grid_Q2_2027_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet stub); Madrid_Market_Adjustments_2027.pdf (report stub)

Hi Sara / Lina,

Thanks — Marcus confirmed the local floor and approval path.

Decision: proceed with an offer in the EUR 108,000 gross base range (this is within the EUR 105k–112k band Marcus suggested). We will include our standard benefits package plus a one-time relocation/remote setup stipend of EUR 2,000 (even for fully remote hires in Madrid) and the standard equity grant for Band 5.

Approval: Monica pre-authorizes an internal exception up to +10% if required to close (monica, please confirm via reply if that's correct). If Lina asks for a number >10% above the midpoint, we will escalate to VP People Ops.

Sara — please present EUR 108,000 as the verbal offer, note that total comp includes benefits and equity, and aim to get a signed offer by Friday so Acme Analytics can lock talent within their window. Recruiter should include the attached comp grid as internal reference only (don't share the benchmark PDFs with the candidate).

Lina — we're excited about your candidacy; let me know if you have any questions about benefits or how we handle remote onboarding for EU-based teammates.

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Talent & People Ops
Redwood Inference
